response.sql: SELECT r.raceId, r.name, AVG(CASE WHEN res.laps IS NULL OR TRIM(res.laps) IN ('', '\N') THEN NULL ELSE CAST(res.laps AS REAL) END) AS average_laps FROM races AS r LEFT JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.positionOrder > 12 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name ORDER BY average_laps IS NULL, average_laps DESC, r.raceId LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff excludes 12th place, so back-of-the-field results have positionOrder greater than 12.
Missing laps are SQL NULL, empty text, or the \N marker.

alternatives.interpretation: Include 12th place in the back-of-the-field results.
